Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : Tender must meet the following qualifying and other eligibility criteria stated in the Tender Documents.
a) General experience of not less than 10 (Ten) Years.
b) Successfully completion of Building works amount of Taka at least 3.50 Crore in a single work order Complete certificate during
the last 5(five) years.
c) The minimum amount of free funds (liquid assets) or available credit facilities net of other contractual commitments shall be Tk.
2.75 Crore (Certificate for proving available liquid assets must be issued within 28 (twenty eight) days from the date of tender
submission).
d) The required average annual construction turn over shall be greater than 10 Crore (Ten Crore) in the last 05 (five) years.
e) The tenderer must also have Update Income Tax certificate (2016-2017), Trade License(2017-2018) and VAT Registration
certificate.
